title: [GMCP 203.002.03] Integration: JSON-RPC, protocol metadata, errors, cancellation, and negotiation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-002-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: GMCP implements the complete JSON-RPC substrate for every supported revision: identifiers and batches where applicable, notifications, cancellation, progress tokens, typed standard and MCP errors, required resultType, per-request protocol/capability metadata, trace context, and deterministic unsupported-version behavior. Malformed, duplicated, reordered, oversized, and adversarial messages fail predictably without corrupting another request. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
